description: A terminal `.catch(h)` with a non-throwing handler is the async bridge — the sanctioned fire-and-forget — and a rethrowing handler is simply a throwing `h`, so it is no bridge with no dedicated detector.

diagnostics.message: `sendTelemetry().catch(rethrow)` is discarded, so nothing handles a rejection and Node escalates one to an uncaught exception: the body producing it was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: `await` it inside a `try`/`catch`, end the chain with a `.catch(h)` whose handler is non-throwing, or make that producer non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
